rationale: The intraday tape remains firmly bearish — price is ~9% below session VWAP and the one candle since entry closed at its lows after rejecting the 10.40–10.41 area — so the short still aligns with the dominant flow and the $10.52 invalidation keeps risk tightly defined. However, the gap to prior close (~$10.39) is now fully filled and price is stalling right at that level with shrinking candle ranges, which limits conviction and argues against adding or flipping. Going long would mean fighting a heavy downtrend with only a gap-fill bounce thesis, which is not meaningfully stronger than flat, so holding the existing short at breakeven one minute in is the best risk-adjusted choice.
